title: Una giornata a Roma
summary: Sara and Luca spend a day sightseeing in Rome.

sentences.l2: Oggi è sabato e Sara e Luca sono a Roma per due giorni.
sentences.en: Today is Saturday and Sara and Luca are in Rome for two days.

sentences.l2: La mattina prendono un caffè in un piccolo bar vicino all'albergo.
sentences.en: In the morning they have a coffee in a small café near the hotel.

sentences.l2: Poi vanno a piedi al Colosseo.
sentences.en: Then they walk to the Colosseum.

sentences.l2: C'è molta gente, ma il Colosseo è bellissimo.
sentences.en: There are a lot of people, but the Colosseum is beautiful.

sentences.l2: A pranzo mangiano una pizza in una piazza.
sentences.en: At lunch they eat a pizza in a square.

sentences.l2: Sara fa molte foto e Luca compra un gelato.
sentences.en: Sara takes lots of photos and Luca buys an ice cream.

sentences.l2: Il pomeriggio fa caldo, allora tornano in albergo e dormono un po'.
sentences.en: In the afternoon it's hot, so they go back to the hotel and sleep a little.

sentences.l2: La sera escono di nuovo: vogliono vedere la città di notte.
sentences.en: In the evening they go out again: they want to see the city at night.

sentences.l2: Trovano un ristorante tranquillo e parlano del loro giorno.
sentences.en: They find a quiet restaurant and talk about their day.

sentences.l2: «Roma è la città più bella del mondo», dice Sara.
sentences.en: 'Rome is the most beautiful city in the world,' says Sara.

a.en: in, at, on (a piedi = on foot)

questions.q: How long are Sara and Luca in Rome?
How do they get to the Colosseum?

questions.explanation: “Il pomeriggio fa caldo, allora tornano in albergo.”

options: It's the most beautiful city in the world
